# This repository's own guard (not installed into other repos; the template's policy is under
# template/). Extended regexes, case-insensitive, matched against every shell command an agent runs.
# A match = the command is denied. Agents cannot edit this file (deny-paths.txt).

# --- Destructive filesystem ---
\brm\s+(-[a-z]*\s+)*(/|~|\$HOME|/\*|\.\.)(\s|$)
\bmkfs\b
\bdd\s+if=.*of=/dev/

# --- Privilege escalation / remote code ---
\bsudo\b
\bchmod\s+(-R\s+)?777\b
\b(curl|wget)\b[^|]*\|\s*(sudo\s+)?(ba|z|)sh\b
\bbash\s+<\(\s*(curl|wget)

# --- Git history and review safety ---
\bgit\s+push\b.*(\s--force(-with-lease)?\b|\s-f\b|\s\+\S)
\bgit\s+(filter-branch|filter-repo)\b
\bgit\s+config\s+(--global|--system)\b
--no-verify\b
\bgit\s+(branch\s+-D|push\s+\S+\s+--delete|push\s+\S+\s+:)\s*(main|master)\b

# --- GitHub: merging to main, repo settings and deletions stay human ---
\bgh\s+pr\s+merge\b
\bgh\s+repo\s+(delete|edit|rename|archive)\b
\bgh\s+api\b.*(-X|--method)\s*DELETE\b
\bgh\s+(secret|variable|ruleset)\b

# --- Secret access ---
\b(cat|less|more|head|tail|bat|nl|strings|xxd|grep|awk|sed|cp|scp)\b[^|;&]*(\.env(\.|\s|$)|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.ssh/|\.aws/credentials|\.npmrc|\.pypirc|\.netrc|\.git-credentials)
^\s*(env|printenv|set)\s*$
\bprintenv\b.*(TOKEN|SECRET|KEY|PASSWORD)
\becho\s+.*\$\{?[A-Z_]*(TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|API_KEY)

# --- Audit log tampering ---
(\brm\b|\bmv\b|\btruncate\b|\bshred\b|sed\s+-i|>\s*)[^|;&]*\.agent-logs

# Human-only factory steps (they start more agents).
\b(new-draft|create-issues?|create-tasks?|run-batch)\.(sh|ps1)\b

# --- Adopted from the template (2026-10-21): GitHub actions a human must do ---
\bgh\s+pr\s+review\b.*--approve
\bgh\s+workflow\s+(run|enable|disable)\b
\bgh\s+auth\s+(token|refresh|login|logout)\b
\bgh\s+api\b.*(-X|--method)\s*(DELETE|PUT|PATCH)
# --- Adopted from the template: stricter git push safety ---
\bgit\s+push\b.*(--force|\s-f(\s|$)|--mirror|--delete|--all|--tags|\s\+\S|\s:\S)
# --- Adopted from the template: cloud / infra changes (agents never deploy) ---
\bterraform\s+(apply|destroy|import|state)\b
\bkubectl\s+(delete|apply|replace|scale|drain)\b
\bhelm\s+(install|upgrade|uninstall|delete)\b
\bpulumi\s+(up|destroy)\b
\bsam\s+deploy\b
\b(cdk|npx\s+cdk)\s+(deploy|destroy|bootstrap)\b
\baws\s+\S+\s+(delete|terminate|remove|put|create|update|attach|detach|modify|deregister)-
# --- Adopted from the template: PowerShell / Windows equivalents ---
(\bRemove-Item\b|\bri\b|\bdel\b|\bMove-Item\b|\bClear-Content\b|\bSet-Content\b|\bOut-File\b|\bAdd-Content\b)[^|;&]*\.agent-logs
\$env:[A-Za-z_]*(TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|API_KEY)
\b(Get-ChildItem|gci|dir|ls)\s+env:
^\s*(Get-ChildItem|gci|dir|ls)\s+env:\s*$
\b(Get-Content|gc|type|Copy-Item|cpi|Select-String|sls)\b[^|;&]*(\.env(\.|\s|$)|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.ssh[\\/]|\.aws[\\/]credentials|\.npmrc|\.pypirc|\.netrc|\.git-credentials)
\b(Remove-Item|ri|del|erase|rd|rmdir)\b.*\s-(Recurse|r)\b.*\s([A-Za-z]:[\\/]?\*?|[\\/]\*?|~|\$env:(USERPROFILE|HOMEDRIVE|SystemRoot)|\$HOME)(\s|$)
\b(Format-Volume|Clear-Disk|Initialize-Disk)\b
\bformat\s+[A-Za-z]:
\b(Set|New|Remove)-ItemProperty\b.*\bHK(LM|CU|CR|U)\b
\breg(\.exe)?\s+(add|delete|import)\b
\b(iex|Invoke-Expression)\b.*\b(iwr|irm|Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-RestMethod|DownloadString)\b
\b(iwr|irm|Invoke-WebRequest|Invoke-RestMethod|curl|wget)\b.*\|\s*(iex|Invoke-Expression)\b
\bSet-ExecutionPolicy\b
\bStart-Process\b.*-Verb\s+RunAs\b
\brunas\b
